scope_note: CryptoRadar keeps news and market sentiment separate from official exchange listing notices, regulator actions, on-chain metrics, and liquidity snapshots. Article-level signals are proxies until canonical exchange, asset-pair, chain, and metric fields are collected from operational sources.
